name: ImagePilot Featured Images
author: Chintan Soni

sections.description:
ImagePilot Featured Images helps WordPress editors upload the correct featured image every time. Display featured image guidelines, image dimensions, recommended image sizes, branding requirements, and upload instructions directly inside the WordPress editor.

Display featured image dimensions, image size requirements, branding rules, file size limits, crop instructions, and editorial guidelines directly inside the WordPress editor. Notes appear beside the Featured Image panel in Gutenberg and Classic Editor, helping content teams maintain consistent image standards across posts, pages, WooCommerce products, and custom post types.

Instead of relying on documentation, emails, spreadsheets, or screenshots, administrators can place featured image guidelines exactly where editors choose and upload images.

ImagePilot Featured Images is a lightweight WordPress plugin designed for content teams, publishers, agencies, marketing departments, WooCommerce stores, and any website that needs consistent featured image standards.

Features

  • Display featured image guidelines directly inside the WordPress editor
  • Set featured image requirements by post type
  • Create unique guidelines for page templates
  • Add individual post-level overrides
  • Gutenberg (Block Editor) support
  • Classic Editor support
  • Screen Options integration
  • Import and export settings
  • Translation ready
  • Admin-only functionality
  • No front-end output
  • Works with custom post types
  • WooCommerce compatible
  • Lightweight and easy to configure

Benefits

  • Improve content publishing consistency
  • Reduce incorrect featured image uploads
  • Help editors follow branding requirements
  • Eliminate separate image guideline documents
  • Standardize featured images across your website
  • Improve editorial workflows
  • Reduce publishing mistakes
  • Save time for content teams and website administrators

Common Use Cases

  • Featured image dimensions (1200 × 630 px)
  • Recommended image sizes
  • Maximum image file size requirements
  • Brand compliance and design guidelines
  • Product image standards
  • Social sharing image specifications
  • Landing page image requirements
  • Editorial workflow instructions
  • Marketing campaign image rules
  • Content publishing checklists

Who Is It For?

  • Content publishers
  • Editorial teams
  • Marketing departments
  • WooCommerce stores
  • Agencies managing client websites
  • News and magazine websites
  • Corporate websites
  • Bloggers and content creators
  • Educational organizations
  • Non-profit organizations

Privacy

ImagePilot Featured Images does not collect, store, transmit, or share any personal data.

Accessibility

ImagePilot Featured Images follows WordPress admin interface standards and supports keyboard navigation where applicable.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → ImagePilot Featured Images.
  4. Configure your featured image guidelines.
  5. Save your settings.
sections.faq:
How do I show featured image size requirements in WordPress?

ImagePilot Featured Images displays featured image requirements directly inside the WordPress editor, helping editors upload the correct image every time.

How do I tell editors what featured image size to upload?

Create featured image guidelines for post types, page templates, or individual posts. The instructions appear directly beside the Featured Image panel.

Does this work with Gutenberg?

Yes. Guidelines appear inside the Gutenberg Block Editor and support per-post overrides.

Does this work with the Classic Editor?

Yes. Guidelines appear below the Featured Image metabox in the Classic Editor.

Can I display featured image dimensions in Gutenberg?

Yes. You can display image dimensions, file size requirements, branding notes, crop instructions, and other featured image guidance.

Can I create featured image rules for WooCommerce products?

Yes. Any supported custom post type, including WooCommerce products, can have its own featured image guidelines.

Can I create different rules for different page templates?

Yes. Each page template can have unique featured image requirements.

Does it support custom post types?

Yes. Public post types that support featured images are automatically detected and supported.

Can I show recommended featured image sizes?

Yes. Display recommended image sizes, dimensions, aspect ratios, and upload instructions directly in the editor.

Can I add featured image guidelines for authors?

Yes. Guidelines help authors and editors follow image requirements before publishing content.

Can I standardize featured images across my website?

Yes. Create consistent featured image rules for posts, pages, products, and custom post types.

Will visitors see these guidelines?

No. All guidelines are displayed only inside wp-admin and never appear on the public website.

Can I export and import settings?

Yes. Export your settings to a JSON file and import them on another website.

Is the plugin translation ready?

Yes. The plugin is translation ready and can be localized into any language.

Does this slow down my website?

No. The plugin runs only inside the WordPress admin area and does not load anything on the front end.
